For Respondent(s) : Mr. Somitra Chaturvedi, Dy. GC with Mr. Munendra Fauzdar HON'BLE
MR. JUSTICE ASHOK KUMAR JAIN Order 29/01/2026 1.

The instant writ petition is preferred by petitioner with following prayer:
"1. The impugned order dated 19.07.2021 by which the humble petitioner has been rendered ineligible for appointment to the post of Sub-Inspector/Platoon Commander may kindly be quashed and set aside and accordingly the respondents may be directed to issue an appointment order in favour of the

] humble petitioner on the post of Sub-Inspector/Platoon Commander with all consequential benefits with effect from the date the person with less merit than the humble petitioner in his category are given appointment in pursuance of the advertisement dated 05.10.2016, in the interest of justice.
2. Any other relief which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case, may also kindly be passed in favour of the petitioner."

3. Considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and also perused the material placed on record.
4.

The issue pertains to recruitment on the post of Sub- Inspector/Platoon Commander wherein the petitioner was denied appointment on the ground that he was involved in a criminal case and this fact was mentioned by the petitioner while filling up the application form.

5. An identical issue was considered by the Division Bench of this Court in the case of Babbal Singh Vs. State of Rajasthan : DB Special Appeal (Writ) No. 971/2022, and also in judgment dated 29.08.2025 in case of Shaitan LaL Kurach Vs. State of (Uploaded on 25/02/2026 at 11:07:13 AM)

sentences.text: 6. The facts of the case indicate that pursuant to advertisement dated 05.10.2016 and further corrigendum dated 23.08.2019 for recruitment on post of Sub-Inspector/Platoon Commander organized by RPSC, the present petitioner was selected in both written and physical examination.

After character verification, the petitioner was not found as fit due to a criminal case registered against the present petitioner and he was declared ineligible for appointment on post of Sub-Inspector/Platoon Commander vide order dated 19.07.2021 (Annexure-10).

7. The petitioner has filed judgment dated 13.08.2019 in Sessions Case No.330/2015 (CIS No.590/2015) passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge (Woman Atrocity Cases) No.2, Jaipur Metropolitan whereby the present person was acquitted from charge under Section 366 and 376/511 IPC as prosecutrix has turned hostile and not supported the case of prosecution.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge (Woman Atrocity Cases) No.2, Jaipur Metropolitan
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This sessions case was registered after filing of charge-sheet in FIR No.106/2015 registered at Jaipur through a compliant filed before the Metropolitan Magistrate, Jaipur Metropolitan.
